白い熊 店 4.8.4+2026-08-02.08-09.g4b717c67+023
• Apps frozen by hiding are now checked for updates — before, a hidden app was invisible to the update check, the Installed list and the Ignored section
• A hidden app counts as frozen: shown in italics, and covered by the “Updates for frozen apps” switch
• New version format naming the upstream base (date, time and commit); the build counter no longer resets on an upstream sync, so a sync build is never a downgrade
